definitions.explanation: A proposal to change or modify an existing plan, bill, or document. Used in legislative, business, and general contexts when suggesting changes to something already drafted.

examples.japanese: {修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}しましょう→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition party submitted a budget amendment to the Diet.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧ (correction, revision) and ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (plan, proposal). Used widely in political, business, and everyday contexts to refer to a proposed change to an existing plan or document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put forward an amendment
- {修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit an amendment (formal)
- {修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass an amendment
- {修正案|しゅうせいあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reject an amendment

USAGE:
In the Japanese Diet (⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧), {修正案|しゅうせいあん} refers specifically to amendments to bills. In business, it can mean any revised draft or plan.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{原案|げんあん}→原案：11978_genan⟧: original proposal — the plan before amendment
- {対案|たいあん}: counterproposal — a completely alternative plan
- ⟦{改正案|かいせいあん}→改正案：20819_kaiseian⟧: reform bill — similar but implies larger-scale change to existing law
